messages:
Riley (AE): kicking off NimbusMed POC thread. They need on-prem app -> Redwood Private. Questions: terminate TLS on-prem vs our ingress? preserve client source IP for their ACLs? PrivateLink DNS setup? Also need rough cost if they require a static egress IP. Can Solutions + NetOps advise?
Sam (Solutions): two patterns we recommend: 1) site-to-site IPsec into customer TGW -> peering to Private VPC (preserves source IP), or 2) IPsec into our edge + PrivateLink (interface endpoints) if customer prefers our managed endpoints. Terminate TLS where they want control; terminate at our ingress if they need our proxy features.
Priya (NetOps): quick ACL checklist for POC:
- allow outbound tcp/443 to redwood control plane CIDRs (we'll send list)
- allow tcp/443 to PrivateLink ENI CIDRs if using interface endpoints
- allow udp/500 & udp/4500 if running IPsec
- allow udp/tcp 53 to resolver for private DNS
Sample SG snippet (paste to their infra):
  allow tcp:443 -> <redwood-cp-cidr>
  allow tcp:443 -> <privatelink-eni-cidr>
  allow udp:500,4500 -> <our-edge-ip>
I'll create an ephemeral test CIDR: 203.0.113.8/30 (72h).
Sam (Solutions): pricing note: if they NAT with an EIP/NATGW, cost is on their side (NAT data processing ~$0.04-0.05/GB). If they want us to provide a managed static egress IP, we can include a monthly fee + bandwidth in SOW; I'll add a placeholder line item.
Leah (Security): SQ items to expect: network diagram, TLS cipher suites + cert chain, mTLS support, SOC2 link, KMS usage and rotation cadence, flow logs & retention. We can supply a template diagram and sample mTLS config.
Riley (AE): action items: 1) Priya: paste SG text to ticket & confirm ephemeral CIDR. 2) Sam: add managed static-egress line to quote with ballpark per-GB. 3) Leah: attach SQ template and diagram. I'll set a 30m handoff with their infra tomorrow.
deploy-bot: provision job succeeded  test endpoint 10.4.22.18 created for NimbusMed POC (lifecycle 72h).
Riley (AE): thanks team, sending to customer now.
